name: Vapid Smuggler Caracara
summary: A Standout Smuggler Caracara that IGN lists as a Key Valuable at an Illegal Operation in Port Gellhorn.
body: IGN calls the Vapid Smuggler Caracara a Standout vehicle and the third of four Key Valuables at the Brooks Boatworks Illegal Operation in Port Gellhorn.
IGN says the bright orange truck is parked in front of the green wooden building, is unlocked with no alarm, and only counts as found once the player gets in.
IGN says it costs 5,550 dollars to register and sells for 6,325 dollars.

facts.availability: Key Valuable at Brooks Boatworks, Port Gellhorn

name: Vapid Truth & Justice Caracara
summary: A Standout Truth & Justice Caracara that IGN lists as a Key Valuable at an Illegal Operation in Port Gellhorn.
body: IGN calls the Vapid Truth & Justice Caracara a Standout vehicle and the third Key Valuable at the June Warehouse Illegal Operation in Port Gellhorn.
IGN says it is parked just east of the main garage, unlocked and without an alarm.
IGN says it costs 5,550 dollars to register and sells for 6,445 dollars.

facts.availability: Key Valuable at June Warehouse, Port Gellhorn

name: Vapid Firebug Dominator
summary: A Standout Firebug Dominator that IGN lists as a Key Valuable at an Illegal Operation in Port Gellhorn.
body: IGN calls the Vapid Firebug Dominator a Standout vehicle and the first of three Key Valuables at the La Cascara Motel Illegal Operation in Port Gellhorn.
IGN says the bright red car is parked on the east side in front of the motel, where hostile thugs gather.
IGN says, unlike the other standout vehicles on its operation pages, it is locked: a window has to be broken or a Slim Jim used before it can be hotwired. IGN gives no register or sale price.

facts.availability: Key Valuable at La Cascara Motel, Port Gellhorn

name: Bombora S23 CCS
summary: The boat IGN says Jason keeps moored off the small dock at his Key Lento safehouse.
body: IGN names Jason's boat as the Bombora S23 CCS, moored off the small dock outside his Key Lento safehouse, one of the vehicles stored there along with his Ganado.
IGN's diving guide says the boat at Jason's safehouse always carries scuba gear, and its Fishing Shacks page lists a Bombora boat among the getaway boats at that operation's dock.
